segments.evidence: Authenticated E2E proves server-derived authenticated identity
profile/workflow/opportunity access is account-scoped in deployed E2E
profile and personalized Radar cache are stored under global device keys
current sign-out does not purge/rebind globally-addressed private cache
server identity changes correctly; local cache boundary is separate
Main hydrates cached profile/opportunities before Account B network reconciliation; BUG-GP-015
no identity-bound fallback prevents Account A cached private state from remaining visible
must not be promoted to device-ready until automated private-cache isolation is repaired

required_device_procedure_after_repair: Account A signs in and loads profile, Radar and one workflow state.
Force offline/slow network after A data is cached.
A signs out and Account B signs in on the same physical device.
Capture every B first-render frame/state before network success.
Verify zero A profile, opportunities, workflow notes or other private tenant data is visible.
Restore network and verify B receives only B tenant state.
Record build SHA, API deployment SHA, A/B account identifiers in redacted form and device/OS evidence.
